query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, co.firstName, co.lastName, ccr.companyId 
FROM companies c 
LEFT JOIN contact_company_relations ccr ON ccr.companyId = c.id 
LEFT JOIN contacts co ON co.id = ccr.contactId 
WHERE c.id = 'ca205926-f593-4788-8e6c-01b91e834797'
